title: Quick-fill Malta expense planner
intro: A blank-by-default planner for 13–19 October 2026. Enter full trip/party amounts in euros (€) consistently; no flight, hotel, meal, fare, ticket, or reimbursement amount has been assumed. Bus and travel-card prices are now published and verified on the transport page if you want a benchmark for the transport rows; the only hotel-side figure with an official basis is the €1.50-per-night eco-contribution for guests aged 18+.

records.name: Flights — all travelers
records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the booked round-trip total, including baggage, seat selection, payment fees, and any changes. Departure airport, airline, traveler count, and booking price have not been provided; do not assume a U.S. gateway or flight itinerary.
records.notes: Malta Airport’s airline directory is for route/provider discovery, not a fare quote. Enter the total from the selected airline’s booking or receipt; if charged in USD, convert using the card/statement rate and note the conversion or fee.
records.price range: Not published; budget and actual fields start blank

records.name: AX ODYCY — full accommodation booking total
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the full booking total and note the confirmed check-in/out dates
records.description: Hotel and Deluxe Sea-View room are user-supplied trip details. No booking confirmation, price, deposit, meal plan, traveler count, or exact check-in/out time was supplied. Enter the confirmed booking total rather than multiplying an assumed nightly rate; do not infer the number of hotel nights from the travel window alone.
records.notes: Official AX ODYCY property page; it is not a quote or confirmation of this reservation. Record any included meals, deposit, cancellation terms, and separately billed hotel charges in the notes field.
records.price range: Not published; booking amount starts blank

records.name: Hotel taxes, environmental contribution, deposits, or other separately billed charges
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Optional line only for charges shown separately on the confirmed hotel invoice. The Malta Tourism Authority's 2026 guidelines require the eco-contribution to be disclosed separately from accommodation fees on a fiscal receipt, at €1.50 per night per guest aged 18+ at the start of the visit and capped at €22.50 per person per visit. Six billable nights would be €9.00 per eligible adult, but whether it is charged here, when, and to whom depends on the booking and the invoice.
records.notes: The 2026 MTA guidelines were read directly: https://mta.com.mt/docs/Eco-Contribution-Accommodation-Guidelines-2026.pdf . The rate, the age test, the per-person cap, the per-night chargeability (whether or not the room is used) and the separate-receipt rule are all explicit. The guidelines' only fifteen-day reference defines an "interruption" — up to fifteen days in premises that do not require to be licensed within one visit — rather than a minimum stay, which is why the six-night figure is treated as ordinary arithmetic rather than an open question. It is still not a confirmed charge for this traveller: enter an amount only if the invoice shows one. Do not double-count it in another row.
records.price range: €1.50 per person per night for guests aged 18+, maximum €22.50 per person per visit; six chargeable nights would be €9.00 per eligible adult. Not a confirmed charge — verify on the hotel invoice.

records.name: Local buses / travel cards
records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Enter the total for the travel card or individual bus fares actually planned. Two published prices are usable for planning: the €27.00 Explore Flex 7-day card, or a €2.50 day-route single as a planning inference. Buying a card removes the single-fare uncertainty for a multi-day stay, which is the better buy here.
records.notes: Fare page read in full 11 October 2026: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/. It dates its €2.00 winter single to 19 October 2025 – 13 June 2026, which ends before this trip, and prints no 2026/27 changeover date, so €2.50 is a planning inference rather than a published trip-week fare. Card terms are clear: €27.00 Explore Flex 7-day includes Day, Night, Airport Direct and Special Services; the cheaper-looking €25 Explore Adult card EXCLUDES tallinja Direct routes, so it would not cover the TD1 airport line — the €2 dearer card is the better buy. €19 buys 12 shareable Single Day Journeys valid 6 months. €50 fine for travelling without a valid ticket. Buy at Buġibba Terminal, the airport, Valletta Terminal or Sliema Ferries. See getting-around.html#mpt-fares-cards and transport record mpt-seasonal-fare-window-2026.
records.price range: Not set; check current fares and card conditions

records.name: AX ODYCY ↔ BLAST Arena Studios event-day travel
records.address: From AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, to the confirmed MFCC/BLAST Arena Studios entrance
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the chosen event-day round-trip amount
records.description: Track the event-day commute separately from general bus spending. The venue and the outbound leg are now settled: Route 186 from Qawra reaches the Ta' Qali Stadium stop in time for even the 09:30 check-in, and the venue's own booklet endorses 186 from the Buġibba side. The return is NOT a bus journey on the late days, so budget five taxi or ride-hailing returns in the taxi-rideshare row rather than here. Enter the bus amount once you have chosen a card or know the single fare you will pay.
records.notes: Published venue days from the event's ticketing page: 09:30 check-in / 10:30 games / to 22:30 on Wed 14 and Thu 15 October, and 14:00 / 15:00 / to 21:00 on Fri 16 October; Sat 17 and Sun 18 were not published. Nearest stop to the venue is 'Stadium', about a 4-minute walk. MPT lists a Saturday 17 October evening Route 186 diversion. One thing could still change the return: MPT runs TQ-numbered special event services out of Ta' Qali, and TQ1's corridor runs through St Paul's Bay and Qawra to Buġibba at the €3.00 Special Services fare — it showed 'Timetable not available!' when checked and no TWC notice was found, so check https://www.publictransport.com.mt/latest-service-updates/ daily during 14–18 October. Route-level times are not a saved door-to-door planner result. See getting-around.html#event-checklist and OQ-H3.
records.price range: Not set; exact date/time route and event return are not confirmed

records.name: Taxi / ride-hailing — five event-night returns
records.address: Not applicable — enter only trips you plan to take
records.hours: Not applicable
records.description: Not a contingency: this is the planned return for all five event nights, because no verified night bus serves Ta' Qali or Attard and the venue day runs to 22:30 on two of them. Budget one return per event day. Quotes, availability and pickup location are trip-specific and prices are dynamic, so enter actual amounts from live quotes rather than planning from a cap.
records.notes: Transport Malta publishes maximum meter rates, but the page footer states 'Page last updated: 06/04/2022', so treat them as possibly revised: https://www.transport.gov.mt/land/public-transport/other-public-transport/taxis-829. From those bands the capped fare works out at roughly €12.40 for 5 km, €19.40 for 10 km, €25.90 for 15 km and €30.90 for 20 km — this guide's arithmetic at assumed distances, excluding waiting (€25/hour) and traffic (€4.20/hour) charges, and NOT a quote. The road distance from AX ODYCY to the venue was never measured. Ride-hailing is dynamic and not bound by the meter tariff, so compare a live Bolt/eCabs/Uber quote against the cap. Pre-book before going in: no taxi rank at an inland studio was verified and demand spikes when everyone leaves at once.
records.price range: Live quote varies; no amount prefilled

records.name: Thunderpick event ticket / spectator access, if applicable
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta — the address on the event’s own ticketing listing.
records.hours: Wednesday 14 – Sunday 18 October 2026, 9:30 AM – 10 PM. Check-in 09:30 and games 10:30 on 14 and 15 October; check-in 14:00 and games 15:00 on 16 October. Ages 18+.
records.description: If attending, this row is for event-related spending — transport, food and drink at the venue, merchandise — not admission: the listing displays a free 'Reserve a spot' option for in-person 18+ attendance. Two things remain unconfirmed and would change the numbers: whether one reservation covers all five days, and whether the venue has parking or catering. Enter only confirmed amounts once the itinerary and any confirmations are in hand.
records.notes: Confirmed 11 October 2026 from the event’s official ticketing listing https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841 : organizer Hotspawn; venue BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard; Wednesday 14 – Sunday 18 October 2026, 9:30 AM – 10 PM; highlights “ages 18+” and “In person”; a free “Reserve a spot” action. Free ticketing is also reported by HLTV: https://www.hltv.org/news/45615/thunderpick-world-championship-talent-revealed . Organizer window and format: https://world-championship.thunderpick.io/2026-finals/ . Thunderpick release naming BLAST Studios Malta: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-returns-to-malta-with-1-million-prize-pool-302850221.html . Still open, so do not budget against them as settled: the Sat 17 and Sun 18 agenda entries, whether one ticket covers all five days, venue parking, and on-site food and drink. This row replaces an earlier version that said spectator access was unconfirmed and quoted a €10.00 precedent from a separate BLAST-run event. Two budget-relevant unknowns remain: whether one registration covers all five days or each day needs its own, and whether there is on-site parking (which would decide if car hire is viable on event days). All nine ticketing-page FAQ answers are client-side and did not render, so neither is answered here — see OQ-H2. No ticket has been secured by this project.
records.price range: Free on the event's own listing — its ticket block shows 'Free' with a 'Reserve a spot' action under a 'Sales end soon' notice. Budget the hidden costs instead: reservation required, 18+ entry with photo ID, and a taxi/ride-hailing or hotel-arranged return because the listed event days outlast the last usable bus. No reservation is held by this project.
